questions.question: Write the specific form of the following a. J→( K. L) J V ( K. L) ∴ K . L b. Y V ( Z. ~Y) Y ∴ ~ (Z. ~Y)
questions.solution_html:
• Tradiitonal logic: Based on Aristotelean logic
  • Uses ordinary language
  • Unit of analysis is terms
  • Limited to simple forms of reasoning
  • Symbolic logic: Based on modern mathematical logic
  • Uses symbols
  • Unit of analysis is proposition
  • Involves simple and complex reasoning

questions.question: Discuss how constants and variables are used in propositional logic and predicate logic. Illustrate
questions.solution_html:
• Simple proposition: Expresses a single idea
  • Contains one variable
  • Eg.p , q
  • Complex proposition: Combines 2 or more simple propositions
  • Contains more than one variable which are connected with \
  • logical connectives
  • Eg. p.q, pv r etc
